contract.intended_consumer: Brian and his coding agents continuing complex claimed projects
contract.outcome: A selected outcome advances from durable current-head receipts without losing custody across runtime continuation.

canonical_journey.starting_state: One exact claimed lane has an immutable selected outcome but no post-selection progress history.
canonical_journey.input: One strict evidence-bound progress receipt whose parent is the current selected lease head.
canonical_journey.action: Append the receipt, replay it, and observe the reconstructed lease through selected pre-write.
canonical_journey.observable_result: The tracker retains one append-only transition and selected pre-write reports its current lease.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Progress is lost, forked, replayed as a new write, or hidden behind the selection-time lease.
